_comment: One entry per office. A property page is only indexed by search engines once it has a size (size_sqft) and at least 3 genuine photos; until then it is published with noindex and left out of the sitemap. Set status to 'let' when an office is taken, or 'hidden' to remove it from the site. Photos go in assets/img/properties/ as WebP files.
